rule.text: A district appears when its sector Location Quotient (LQ) ≥ 1.15 and share ≥ 3% of provincial GPP (NESDC 2024p), or when a speciality has LQ ≥ 1.8. Ranked by output above the national norm.
rule.county_note: Provincial NESDC 2024p GPP specialization mapped to each province's districts.

catalog.name: Campus
catalog.description: Education, information & communications, and professional/scientific/technical value added (NESDC GPP).

catalog.name: Commercial hub
catalog.description: Financial & insurance activities, wholesale/retail trade, and real estate (NESDC GPP).

catalog.name: Industrial zone
catalog.description: Manufacturing and mining & quarrying value added (NESDC GPP — Rayong, Chon Buri, Ayutthaya, Lamphun, Samut Prakan).

catalog.name: Entertainment complex
catalog.description: Accommodation, food services, arts & recreation value added (NESDC GPP — Phuket, Krabi, Phang Nga, Surat Thani).

catalog.name: Harbor
catalog.description: Transportation and storage value added in coastal or Chao Phraya corridor provinces (NESDC GPP).

catalog.name: Government plaza
catalog.description: Public administration, defence, and human health value added (NESDC GPP).

catalog.name: Aqueduct & dam
catalog.description: Electricity, gas, water supply and construction value added (NESDC GPP — Lampang, Ratchaburi, Kanchanaburi).

catalog.name: Granary & farmstead
catalog.description: Agriculture, forestry and fishing specialization (NESDC GPP — Isan rice bowl, Southern rubber/palm & Northern orchards).
